subject: defrag: use monotime in module interface (#1388)
reason: The change is an internally consistent clock refactor with no behavior the fuzzer can observe. Both the producer (defragLaterItem in defrag.c, which previously converted the monotonic deadline to wall-clock) and the consumer (VM_DefragShouldStop and the ValkeyModuleDefragCtx.endtime field in module.c) switched to monotime together, the endtime==0 'no deadline' sentinel used by moduleDefragValue and moduleDefragGlobals is preserved, and ValkeyModuleDefragCtx is defined privately in module.c, so modules see only the unchanged boolean of DefragShouldStop. The only semantic difference is robustnes
